leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a table structure with HTML and populate it with JavaScript data
Implement sorting functionality for table columns with click handlers
Apply filtering logic to display rows based on user input criteria
Initialize and manipulate state variables to track sort order and filter values
Bind event listeners to UI controls for interactive table operations
Render dynamic table updates based on current sort and filter conditions
Integrate sorting and filtering features into a cohesive user interface
lessonTitle: Build a sortable and filterable table
